PRIVACY

Your information.

Last updated September 30, 2026.

What the site does

The contact form sends your name, email, topic, preferred language, consent and any optional phone number or note to Formspree for routing to Kostyantyn Mykhalchenko at Pavel Boubnov – Barrister & Solicitor. These details are used to respond to your enquiry; the form does not subscribe you to marketing. It does not accept document uploads. Site code does not save your entries in browser local storage. For questions about your information, contact info@halifaxlaw.ca. See the Formspree privacy policy for its processing practices. Checklists and community search operate in your browser. Their values are not saved or transmitted by the site code.

Hosting and external links

The website is hosted by OpenAI Sites. The hosting provider may process technical connection information and, when access is restricted, information needed for authentication. Consult the provider’s privacy policy for details.

External links take you to other websites governed by their own policies. Telephone and email links open the corresponding application on your device. This website does not record calls or store the contents of emails you send. Email sent to info@halifaxlaw.ca is addressed to the practice; avoid sending confidential documents before receiving instructions.

Your legal information

Before sending sensitive documents, verify the recipient’s identity and agree on a transmission method. External organizations explain their own information-handling practices.
